findings.resolution: The separate advisory consumer replays module-pinned A3/A4/A5 inputs, complete request and graph roots, current governance and run immutability; specialist failures cannot mutate facts or release authority.
Every outcome append and service read replays the authoritative stored run, module-pinned contracts, exact evidence and bounded persisted incident history before exposing a non-authorizing candidate.
Incident and correction targets use typed keys and run-derived artifact hashes; duplicate evidence, tests, target keys, outcome IDs and ambiguous bare identifiers fail closed.

A shared recursive safety boundary rejects credential, machine-path and file-URI variants without echoing them, while JSON and service reads enforce exact project scope and preserve safe HTTPS/API routes.
PostgreSQL and SQLite reject mutation, PostgreSQL also rejects truncation, SQLite releases handles, and all adapters require exact stored predecessor chains before child effects.

Only classified initialization unavailability falls back through PostgreSQL, SQLite, JSON and process cache. Health reports run/outcome modes and conservative durability; schema, replay, corruption, conflict and ambiguous-write errors do not fall through.

The capability remains FOUNDATION. Live PostgreSQL verification, public HTTP/MCP access, signed anchoring, historical-policy replay, remaining outcome kinds, A3/A6 linkage and an adjudicated corpus are explicitly retained in canonical docs and the review ledger.
